TEMPOX: Brain & Reflex · Package cloud.bizflow.tempox · Last updated: August 2026

1. WHO IS THE RESPONSIBLE DEVELOPER
The TEMPOX: Brain & Reflex app is developed and maintained by Elias Chanisso / Biz-Flow. For any privacy-related matter, use the support channel at the end of this policy.
2. DATA COLLECTED BY THE APP
TEMPOX was designed to work mostly offline. Whenever data processing happens, it is limited to:
- Anonymous advertising identifiers: when ads are served via Google AdMob, device advertising identifiers may be used for ad selection and frequency capping. You can revoke this identifier in your Android settings (Privacy > Ads > Delete advertising ID). - In-app purchase verification: purchases (such as ad removal) are processed by Google Play Billing; purchase tokens are validated against the Google Play Store to guarantee delivery. - Basic crash and performance metrics: on failures, anonymous technical data (error type, device model, OS version) may be collected solely for fixes and stability. - Local data: score, XP, coins, records and unlocked modes are stored only on the device itself (local preferences), never sent to developer servers.
We do not collect name, email, phone number, precise location or sensitive data.
3. YOUR RIGHTS (LGPD / GDPR)
Under the Brazilian General Data Protection Law (LGPD) and the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you may request at any time:
- Confirmation of processing and access to your data; - Correction of incomplete or outdated data; - Deletion of processed data; - Withdrawal of consent (for example by disabling ad personalization in the system or uninstalling the app, which erases local data).
Just send a request to the support email below; we will reply within the legal deadline.
4. CHILDREN PRIVACY
TEMPOX does not target marketing at minors and declares compliance with child protection guidelines (COPPA/GDPR-K and Google Play Families policies). We do not knowingly collect data from children under 13. Guardians who identify any improper collection must contact support for immediate deletion.
5. PERMISSIONS USED
- Vibration: haptic feedback on hits and combos. - No access to camera, microphone, contacts, files or location.
6. CHANGES TO THIS POLICY
Relevant changes will be reflected on this page with a new update date. Continued use of the app after changes implies awareness of the current version.
7. OFFICIAL SUPPORT CHANNELS
Data deletion requests, consent withdrawal or any privacy question can be sent through the official channels:
- Email: bizflow.cloud@gmail.com - WhatsApp: +258 840636794
